svg.title: Texts Per Contract: The Skill Ladder
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-03-texts-per-contract-ladder; chapter number: 3; chart type: waterfall; title: Texts Per Contract: The Skill Ladder; subtitle: How reported texting volume per contract falls as operator skill rises; caption: Reported texts per contract range from 250,000 at the top of Clay Hepler's logs down to 5,000 for a skilled Apke Brothers texter; each step down is the gap to the next cited benchmark.; assumptions note: Total and result bars are reported benchmarks; each deduction is the arithmetic gap between two adjacent reported benchmarks, not a separately reported figure.; note: Attributed to Clay Hepler, Michael Bull (PMSn1EaZ42Y), and the Apke Brothers (Ls2lelB6ImM) as summarized in practitioner testimony on texting acquisition.; bars: label: Hepler Upper Texting Range; value: 250000; display: 250,000 texts per contract; kind: total; label: Bull Unskilled Ceiling; value: -210000; display: -210,000 (down to 40,000 texts); kind: deduction; label: Apke Beginner Benchmark; value: -20000; display: -20,000 (down to 20,000 texts); kind: deduction; label: Bull Skilled Benchmark; value: -10000; display: -10,000 (down to 10,000 texts); kind: deduction; label: Apke Skilled Texter; value: -5000; display: -5,000 (down to 5,000 texts); kind: deduction; label: Skilled Texts Per Contract; value: 5000; display: 5,000 texts per contract; kind: result
